title: Old Debts
summary: Osric Hale says Garrow's sergeants in Wickham Keep tell the road that Brannoc, the deserter Garrow kept chained in the cellars, owes them. The Watch holds a debt to the Redhand is no debt, and wants it settled.

steps.journal: Defeat three Redhand sergeants in Wickham Keep. They are the Redhand's elites and lead every fifth wave; you'll know them by their shouting.

ready: Three of Garrow's sergeants are down. Tell Osric Hale at the Watch post by Thornwick's well.
done: You put down the sergeants who kept Brannoc's chain oiled. Osric drew a line through the debt they said he owed.
